verdict:
KILL - and the classification matters as much as the verdict. This is a data kill: the decisive input is unobtainable, and per response taxonomy price gates are valuation instruments that do not belong on an unresolvable-solvency binary.

YOU CANNOT ARGUE DAMAGE-ABSENT AGAINST AN ISSUER'S OWN GOING-CONCERN CONCLUSION. Substantial doubt appears in THREE consecutive filings - the FY2025 10-K in March 2026, the Q1 10-Q in May 2026, and the Q2 10-Q on 2026-08-10 - and it is UNALLEVIATED in the most recent one, with mitigation plans that 'cannot be deemed probable'. The maturity arithmetic behind it: $104.2M of short-term bank borrowings plus a $41.7M bond due 2027-01-31 equals $145.9M against $127.8M of unrestricted cash. The narrative the screen implied is confirmed by the issuer in primary text, which is the end of the damage-absent question.

THE DECISIVE VARIABLE IS STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE, AND IT ARRIVES FREE. What actually determines the outcome is Chinese bank rollover intent plus PRC repatriation capacity to the Delaware holding company. No public primary source discloses either, and no bench can litigate what nobody publishes. Meanwhile the answer prints on or about 2026-11-09 at zero cost. Paying a full bench cycle to front-run an unobservable is the wrong trade, and the triage says so in exactly those terms.

THREE FINDINGS WORTH KEEPING REGARDLESS OF THE VERDICT. First, the reported profit is reflexive and non-cash: year-to-date net income of +$36.2M exists only because of a $58.0M favourable fair-value swing on warrant liability and convertible loan - the company booked income BECAUSE its own stock collapsed. The operating result was -$9.7M. Every headline reading 'posts profit yet flags going concern' is describing a mark-to-market artifact, not earnings. Second, disclosure was withdrawn at the decisive moment: the Q2 2026 call carried NO analyst Q&A, and management addressed neither the going concern, nor the short-term borrowing rollover, nor the January 2027 bond, nor repatriation, nor dilution. When the single load-bearing question is liquidity and the Q&A is removed, the nondisclosure IS the finding. Third, the RMB 800M MPS facility does not solve the problem - it is ring-fenced to Huzhou capacity capex and cannot fund holdco liquidity, while the Clarksville full-scale build remains 'contingent on securing additional financing or strategic partnerships'. Cash rose in H1 on restricted-use borrowings, not on operations.

AND THE SCREEN'S LOUDEST SIGNAL WAS A FALSE POSITIVE WORTH ROUTING BACK. The 25-NSE filed 2026-07-22 is NOT a common-stock delisting notice - it removed the public WARRANT class (27.6M warrants, $11.50 strike) that expired unexercised on 2026-07-23. The 2026-08-07 8-K is likewise benign (Item 5.02, a chief accounting officer appointment). Anything downstream that treated the 25-NSE as a delisting event should be corrected.

The genuinely arresting dispersion is real and should be recorded honestly: a $291M market cap on roughly 30% gross margin, positive Q2 adjusted EBITDA (+$3.6M), revenue stabilising (Q2 -4.5% after Q1's -48%), positive working capital of ~$31.2M and only ~$17M of net debt. The binding constraint is holdco refinancing ACCESS, not unit economics. But the resolution path most likely runs through equity issuance at $0.84 and/or a reverse split - MVST has already burned both 180-day bid-price compliance windows in 2024-25 and is back below $1 - which destroys the entry math whichever way the credit question resolves.

court.record: batch4 8/15; red None/blue None NO COURT - triage-routed on a court-worthiness score of 4/10. The single REFUTABILITY artifact (2026-08-15 14:14Z) is the entire record, and it correctly classifies its own conclusion as a DATA-BLOCKING kill rather than a valuation gate.

reopen_gates: EVENT (the flip condition, and it is precise): a disclosed refinancing or retirement of the $41.7M bond due 2027-01-31, OR a Q3 10-Q that ALLEVIATES substantial doubt - while the market cap is still sub-$400M. Either would convert this into a genuine damage-absent re-rate candidate. This is a tripwire, not a court.

DATA (blocking by construction, and unlikely to close): Chinese bank rollover intent on the $104.2M of short-term borrowings, and PRC repatriation capacity to the Delaware holdco. No public primary source carries either; without them no bench can add anything to the triage.
DISCLOSURE: restoration of analyst Q&A addressing liquidity. The Q2 call removed it on the single load-bearing question, and its return would be a genuine change in management posture.
STRUCTURE: any reverse split or equity issuance at these levels re-bases the entry arithmetic entirely - re-underwrite from scratch rather than carrying forward the current dispersion.
